title: Emit a declared completion diagnostic for absent or mismatched reported commands
outcome: A declared completion that becomes UNKNOWN through command association mismatch has an internal diagnostic without reading its artifact.
acceptance: An absent or mismatched reported command produces a bounded fixed UNKNOWN diagnostic identifying command association mismatch without command/artifact/test text.
Tests cover absent and mismatched completion association, unchanged UNKNOWN outcome and absence of artifact reads; no public field or recognition authority is added.
